records.rationale: The diff does port array-based destinationCalendar handling into larkcalendar (e.g. `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` in createEvent/updateEvent/deleteEvent/createAttendees) and office365calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` in createEvent), and the only test change in the diff is a fixture update in webhook.e2e.ts. No unit tests accompany this nontrivial behavioral change across three providers, so the concern is specific, grounded in the diff, and not a bug claim.
